title: Prepare approved private disposable CD target
classification_reason: creates security evidence for a later dynamic deployment
expected_outcome: A GitHub-protected release path and a verified, private disposable CD target have non-sensitive evidence and an explicit execution boundary for later dynamic CI/CD verification.
constraints: Use the existing GITHUB_TOKEN unchanged; do not print tokens, secrets, endpoint URLs, raw scanner output, certificates, or telemetry.
Do not deploy node workloads, initialize or unseal Vault, publish container artifacts, or create a GitHub Release in this task.
Only private, disposable infrastructure may be used for readiness verification; no public endpoint may be enabled.
Any unavailable prerequisite remains a failed readiness condition, never a manually asserted pass.

external_actions: read GitHub repository protection and Actions metadata
configure the protected release Environment, branch/tag protection, and non-secret Actions variables when absent
read non-sensitive AWS/EKS/Vault/observability metadata for the approved private target
prohibited_actions: secret read, creation, alteration, or logging

primary_owner.responsibility: security decisions, integration, and final sign-off

delegations.escalation_trigger: missing permission or a sensitive value
secret material, unauthorized external mutation, or unproven readiness
